text: XLIII. 1. Kati nu kho bhante vivādamūlānī ti? 2. Dasa kho Upāli vivādamūlāni. Katamāni dasa? 3. Idh'; Upāli bhikkhū anāpattiṃ āpattī ti dīpenti, āpattiṃ anāpattī ti dīpenti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ garukāpattī ti dīpenti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ lahukāpattī ti dīpenti, duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ aduṭṭhullāpattī ti dīpenti, aduṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ duṭṭhullāpattī ti dīpenti, sāvasesaṃ āpattiṃ anavasesāpattī ti dīpenti, anavasesaṃ āpattiṃ sāvasesāpattī ti dīpenti, [page 079] XLIII. 3-XLIV. 4 Akkosa-Vagga. 79 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] sappaṭikammaṃ āpattiṃ appaṭikammāpattī ti dīpenti, appaṭikammaṃ āpattiṃ sappaṭikammāpattī ti dīpenti. Imāni kho Upāli dasa vivādamūlānī ti.
